Dogs with Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD)
ACI is currently enrolling patients in a longitudinal sample collection study to investigate disease progression in healthy and early-stage CKD patients. This year long study is looking for dogs with Stage 1 or early Stage 2 CKD, as well as healthy dogs for participation.
Read More
Dogs with Chronic Inflammatory Enteropathy (Enrollment has now closed)
ACI is currently enrolling patients in a multicenter, randomized, masked, placebo-controlled, clinical trial to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of a potential new treatment for canine chronic inflammatory enteropathy (also known as idiopathic inflammatory bowel disease or IBD).
Read More
ON HOLD — Dogs with Idiopathic Epilepsy
ACI is currently enrolling patients in a prospective, randomized, placebo-controlled, multicenter clinical trial to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of an investigational oral therapy for the control of seizures in treatment naïve dogs with idiopathic epilepsy.
Read More
Pain management study in dogs undergoing Tibial Plateau Leveling Osteotomy (TPLO) Surgery
ACI is currently enrolling patients in a multicenter, randomized, placebo-controlled, clinical trial to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of a potential new injectable treatment for postoperative pain control in dogs undergoing TPLO surgery.
Read More
Dogs with Oral Melanoma (Enrollment has now closed)
This fully funded, randomized, placebo-controlled clinical trial will assess a potential new treatment for oral melanoma in dogs.
Read More
